trust.title: The four questions we answer before you sign anything.
trust.alt: Truestack team collaborating in the Kuala Lumpur office

items.question: Where does our borrower data live?
items.answer: On your own secure cloud in Malaysia, kept separate from every other lender we work with. Your borrower files never sit in a shared tenancy. That is the default for every TrueKredit™ deployment.

items.question: Will this survive an audit?
items.answer: Every action is logged with who did it and when, and KPKT paperwork generates from the same records your team works in. Auditors see one trail, not a pile of spreadsheets and folders. That is how TrueKredit™ stays audit-ready by default.

items.question: What if we only need one of your APIs?
items.answer: Yes. TrueIdentity™ e-KYC, TrueSSM™ company checks and our payment rails can each connect to the system you already run, via API — you do not have to move your loan book onto TrueKredit™. Take one service or take several. We will tell you what that integration involves, and what it costs, before you commit.

items.question: How long until we are live?
items.answer: Around three months for a full digital licence conversion, and less if you are only moving an existing loan book onto TrueKredit™. A new KPKT application takes longer because the regulator sets the pace, not the software.

items.question: Do you handle Shariah digital lending as well as a conventional KPKT licence?
items.answer: Yes. A conventional digital licence is kebenaran tambahan on an existing lesen PPW, and the book runs on TrueKredit™ Pro. Shariah digital lending is a separate upcoming KPKT approval — its own entity, Shariah committee and contracts — and runs on TrueSyariah™. The two licences cannot sit in the same operating company. We scope both paths; start at truestack.my/services/digital-license or truestack.my/truesyariah.
